summary: AIPAC named Crank an endorsed pro-Israel candidate in July 2026, and Vote for Peace rated him Opposed for the general election. His October 7 anniversary remarks and a written response to a constituent both framed the attack around Jewish victims while omitting Palestinian deaths and displacement in Gaza.
